dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit sharp high-contrast transitions. Multiple light-intensity (off-white) curvilinear perimeters enclose darker (charcoal) interior regions. The edge geometry is characterized by irregular, slightly jagged borders with steep intensity gradients between the light ring-lines and dark centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of localized solid high-intensity blobs; light-colored pixels are primarily organized into thin interconnected networks rather than solid clusters. High density of low-intensity (dark) solid pixel clusters is observed, serving as the centers for the annular structures and the primary dorsal background color.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the four most prominent macro-annuli on the mid-dorsal region form an irregular quadrilateral. A secondary linear relationship is visible among three smaller annuli aligned along the lower posterior-lateral flank.

other_distinctive_markers: The subject exhibits a continuous, interlocking 'marbled' or 'map-like' topology where individual annular boundaries merge into a complex mesh covering the majority of the visible dorsal-lateral surface.
